# Quotients, orbits and topological stacks

Masullo’s Appendix E contains reusable category theory. The principal construction still needed there is the site of bounded-size compactly generated weak Hausdorff spaces with the submersive-covering topology. Chapter 8 also contains a false uniqueness assertion before its stack calculations.

**Proposition 8.2.0.4(1),(2), p. 386.** Fix a finite place $v$ and take $x=e_v$, whose $v$ coordinate is zero and whose other coordinates are one. The identity idele and the idele with a uniformizer at $v$ and one elsewhere both fix $x$. Their inverse translates are $x=τ(1)e_v$, which belongs to the printed half-open section since the residue field has more than one element. Their quotient lies outside the embedded local unit group. This contradicts uniqueness modulo that group for both the S-local and global **full** idele groups as printed. The proof itself computes the stabilizer in the full group as the whole local multiplicative group, and in the norm-one subgroup as the local units. Restricting the transporter to norm one is a candidate correction for the integrator. Theorem 8.3.0.1(1) explicitly cites the proposition on p. 388. That use should be rechecked if the group is corrected. In a local Lean scratch proof, multiplication of the zero-at-v adele by an arbitrary embedded local unit of the field was verified using Mathlib’s actual adele ring and only the three allowed axioms. Checked against the page image.

**Verification.** Links identify the inspected commits and paths. Mathlib at 4.36.0 passed `#check` and `#print axioms` for all Mathlib declarations above in `.agent/ScoutGeometryCheck.lean`. PiBase’s Apache-2.0 declaration from Lean 4.33.0-rc2 compiled unchanged on 4.36.0 in `.agent/ScoutWeakHausdorff.lean`; the projection used only the repository’s permitted axioms. TauCeti uses 4.37.0-rc1, AxiomMath/Stacks and Hanke use 4.35.0, and AxiomMath/DedekindZetaZeroFree uses 4.35.0-rc3. These projects have Apache-2.0 licenses. Their cited declarations have definitions or proof bodies with no direct `sorry` found. Their dependency closures were not recompiled or axiom-audited here. Negative results record the limits of this search.

Searches used the relevant paper sections, the pinned Mathlib source, the local cross-repository Lean filename index and selected source trees, GitHub code search, and individual GitHub directories where recursive tree results were truncated. Nearby hits from sheaf Čech cohomology, finite group characters, and scheme-specific quotient stacks require different hypotheses. No source I inspected supplies Masullo’s full topology on the spaces of idelic Z-functions or his global-to-S-local structure theorem.
